mapper.sql: SEQ AS seq, USER_ID AS userId, SELECTED_USER_ID AS selectedUserId, CORP_NAME AS custCompName, UPT_DATE AS uptDate, UPT_ID AS uptId, CHECKED_YN AS chkedYn

WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND STATUS = '승인'
AND SEQ != #{excludeSeq}
AND SEQ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND CORP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND BIZ_NUM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_company ( USER_ID, SELECTED_USER_ID, CORP_NAME, UPT_DATE, UPT_ID, CHECKED_YN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{selectedUserId}, #{custCompName}, NOW(), #{uptId}, 'Y' )

INSERT INTO customer_company ( USER_ID, SELECTED_USER_ID, CORP_NAME, UPT_DATE, UPT_ID, CHECKED_YN ) VALUES
( #{item.userId}, #{item.selectedUserId}, #{item.custCompName}, NOW(), #{item.uptId}, 'Y' )
mapper.select:
SELECT SEQ AS seq, USER_ID AS userId, PERSON AS person, CORP_NAME AS corpName, BIZ_NUM AS bizNum, PHONE AS phone, USER_LEVEL AS userLevel, REG_DATE AS regDate, LAST_LOGIN AS lastLogin, STATUS AS status FROM USER
ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT #{skip}, #{amount}
